migrationPolicy: Binary visual/media assets remain byte-identical. Source modules may be explicitly adapted for the Tauri five-provider UI when both source and destination hashes are recorded.

files.adaptation: Extended the upstream zh/en/ja dictionary with bounded CLI diagnostics and recovery actions inside the existing Tauri settings panel; no binary media was changed. R7 adds CodeWhale doctor command-surface/project-overlay labels and Aider config/credential-presence labels in zh/en/ja while retaining R6 authentication and route summaries. R11 (2026-07-30) adds tray.launchCodewhale/tray.launchOpencode/tray.launchAider/tray.launchAgent labels in zh/en/ja so the native tray menu can fully localize the 5-provider launch submenu. R12 (2026-07-30) adds shape.hidePet in zh/en/ja as the Tauri-native replacement for the Electron menubar mode (Tauri has no menubar; tray-only hides the pet window). R15 (2026-07-30) restores the Codex panel i18n keys (codexToday/codexLifetime/codexBreakdown/codexLocalHistory) in zh/en/ja so the panel can render Codex 5h quota and today/lifetime tokens once the Rust-side codex-watch equivalent populates the data. R16 (2026-07-30) restores the metric switching (metricTokens/metricCost) and usage diagnostics (diagScan/diagCorrections/diagEstimated/diagStale/diagNever) plus the hours/cal summary template keys in zh/en/ja so the panel can toggle Token/Cost views and show transcript scan staleness. AUDIT-FIX (2026-07-30): i18n-ized hardcoded Chinese in today-tokens, win-reset, cal mouseover, renderByModel, renderProviderCost; added panel.estimatedRounds/unknownRounds/total keys in zh/en/ja. R18 (2026-07-30): upgraded panel.modelDetail to use {cw5}/{cw1} split placeholders; added panel.tokCacheWrite5m/tokCacheWrite1h keys in zh/en/ja for the dual-row token detail. R19 (2026-07-30): added 9 sess.* keys (search/filters/filterAll/filterAttention/showArchived/pin/unpin/archive/unarchive) in zh/en/ja for session list pin/archive/attention features. R24 (2026-07-30): fixed double-dollar in hoursSummaryCost/calSummaryCost templates (removed literal $ before {total}/{peakV} since fmtCost already includes currency symbol). R26 (2026-07-30): i18n-ized STATE_META labels (13 states), aggregateCostText (3 strings), waiting detail, ops empty — all now use t() calls.
